subject: Staging pass, escort, and sample shipment plan for Redwood booth
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Ana Lopez <ana@mosconecenter.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Staging pass + escort request — sample crate BL-44912 arriving 9/9

Ana —

We’re confirmed for booth C17 (West Hall) and have a sample crate scheduled to arrive with BlueLine (AWB BL-44912) on Friday 2027-09-09 ~10:00am. A couple of asks so we can finalize the mutual action plan: 

- Can you confirm exhibitor/staging passes for 4 people (2 sales, 1 onsite engineer, 1 ops) and whether we can add 2 more if needed?
- Is vehicle access limited to Loading Dock 3? Driver ETA is 10:00 — will they be able to stage and unload the crate close to our booth, or do we need pallet jack/forklift assistance?
- Do you provide an escorted path from dock to booth? If so, please confirm available escort windows (we prefer 9:30–12:00).
- Can you send the latest dock/staging map and gate instructions for the driver?

Crate details: BL-44912, 1 pallet, 220 lbs, contains 3 demo units, assorted collateral. I’ll attach the packing list in the next note.

Thanks — we’re on a tight ramp to get the demo pit fully set by end of day 9/9.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ana Lopez <ana@mosconecenter.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging pass + escort request — sample crate BL-44912 arriving 9/9

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — we’re all set to support your move-in. See answers inline and attached: staging_map_v2.pdf (dock layout + preferred escort route).

- Exhibitor passes: We can issue 6 exhibitor/staging passes for Red wood (physical badges). Please complete the attached exhibitor_pass_request_form.pdf and email it back by 9/8 5pm to secure them.
- Loading dock: Yes, use Loading Dock 3 (West). Drivers must check in at Gate B and will be directed to Dock 3 by the guard.
- Unloading: We have pallet jack assistance available between 08:00–16:00. Forklift assistance must be requested 48 hours prior (we can arrange if you confirm weight distribution).
- Escort: We provide escorted transfers from the dock to booth during scheduled windows. Friday 9/9 escorts are available 09:30–12:30 and 13:30–16:00. Please provide a preferred window.

One note: after-hours unload (after 18:00) incurs a labor surcharge — not applicable for your current ETA.

Attached: staging_map_v2.pdf (includes Gate B check-in), and I’ll hold the exhibitor passes until I receive the completed form.

Regards,
Ana Lopez
Exhibitor Services — Moscone Center
ana@mosconecenter.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging pass + escort request — sample crate BL-44912 arriving 9/9

Quick internal plan —

1) I attached the demo_pack_packing_list.xlsx (rough packing list for the crate). Please confirm that all three demo units are powered down and boxed with AV cables in the front compartment.
2) Let’s request 6 exhibitor passes (two more than Rishi asked for) — one for our sponsor rep (BrightSponsor) if they join the demo rotation. Rishi, can you fill the exhibitor_pass_request_form and send to Ana by EOD 9/8?
3) Logan — can you take lead on scheduling the 30-min booth walkthrough with venue contact on 9/10 at 11:00? We should do a walk with the AV/rigging team to confirm sightlines.
4) Who will pick up badges at Gate B? I can collect them if Rishi or Logan are with the driver.

I’ll also pre-stage a small tool kit (screwdrivers, gaffer tape, labeler) and bring an iPad to check the packing list at handoff.

—Marissa
VP, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: BlueLine Logistics <ops@bluelineco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 07:58:00 -0700
Subject: AWB BL-44912 — scheduled delivery to Moscone (Dock 3) 9/9 08:00–11:00

Good morning Rishi / Marissa,

BlueLine here — confirming AWB BL-44912 is on schedule for delivery to Moscone Center Loading Dock 3 on 2027-09-09 between 08:00–11:00. Driver: Miguel Santos, plate ABC-724.

Driver checklist provided:
- Gate B arrival, show photo ID + AWB (we’ll have a printed copy)
- Contact number on arrival: +1 (415) 555-0124
- Crate: 1 pallet, 220 lbs, 48x40x60 in

Attached: blue_line_awb_44912.pdf (electronic AWB). Please advise if you need us to coordinate a specific escort window; default ETA is 09:30 onsite which lines up with Ana’s escort availability.

Thanks,
BlueLine Logistics Ops
ops@bluelineco.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Lopez <ana@mosconecenter.com>, BlueLine Logistics <ops@bluelineco.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging pass + escort request — sample crate BL-44912 arriving 9/9

Thanks all — summary and next steps: 

- Marissa: please submit exhibitor_pass_request_form.pdf for 6 badges by EOD (Ana confirmed holds). You’ll pick up badges at Gate B — bring company ID.
- BlueLine: thanks for the AWB and driver info. Miguel should check in at Gate B ~09:00 and we’ll meet him at Dock 3 for unloading (09:30 escort window confirmed).
- Logan: schedule the 9/10 11:00 walkthrough with Ana and AV lead. Please add me and Marissa.
- Ana: we’ll use pallet jack assistance and do a escorted transfer 09:30–10:15. No forklift needed.

I’ve uploaded the final packing list and map here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-demo-staging — feel free to annotate. I’ll be onsite during move-in.

—Rishi
